title: Project Planning
description: Learn to plan projects effectively with work breakdown structures, realistic timelines, and resource management.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Project Planning.

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn about Getting Started and how to apply it in real-world scenarios within the context of Project Planning.
Core Concept: Getting Started
This lesson covers the fundamentals of Getting Started. You'll learn practical techniques you can apply immediately in your project planning projects.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: Practice Getting Started with real examples before moving to the next lesson.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Getting Started without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main goal of learning Getting Started in Project Planning?
content.explanation: The goal is to build a solid foundation in Getting Started that you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Getting Started to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
